Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. GreenwayAI runs a 12-week accelerator and were evaluating Redwood for a cohort pilot in Q2. Quick questions before we schedule a follow-up:

- We have an existing referral credit from a partner (one-off $3k). Can that be stacked with Redwoods pilot credits or other promos?
- For each company in the cohort (expect ~6), whats a recommended consumption cap for a 90-day pilot so we dont exceed budgetary approvals?
- If we convert a pilot company to Dedicated later, can unused pilot credits be applied toward a Dedicated commit or are they forfeited?

I attached a short SOW for context. Were happy to share procurement timelines if you can outline next steps (PO, SOW, DocuSign).

Appreciate any flexibility on stacking — this helps make the economics work for smaller founders.

Hi Samira —

Great to e-meet — thanks for the clear questions. Below is a concrete proposal based on the cohort size and a standard 90-day pilot:

1) Promotional stacking
- We can allow stacking of up to two promotional one-time credits for this pilot (e.g., partner referral + Redwood pilot credit), with the following guardrails: combined promo credit cannot exceed 60% of the pilots total estimated consumption value.

2) Per-company consumption cap (recommended)
- Suggested cap: $5,000 USD per company for the 90-day pilot period. Rationale: this covers ~200–300k tokens/month typical ML workloads at pilot scale and prevents surprise billing while leaving headroom for exploration.

3) Conversion to Dedicated and application of unused credits
- If a cohort company converts to Redwood Dedicated within 120 days after pilot end, we will credit 50% of any remaining pilot promo credits toward the first month of Dedicated commit (applied as a one-time credit on the invoice). Unused credits outside of that window are forfeited.

4) One-off promotional discount
- As an accelerator partner concession, Redwood can approve a one-time additional promotional discount of 20% on overage pricing for the pilot period (applies after the per-company cap is reached and only to the pilot cohort). This requires approval from Revenue Ops; Im including Irene on the thread to confirm operational feasibility.

Operational checklist / next steps:
- Ill send an updated Promo Terms spreadsheet (attached) with the cap, stacking fields, and DocuSign-ready language.
- Procurement: we accept PO + DocuSign SOW. Procurement contact details and billing address will be required for the contract.
- If GreenwayAI signs, please send PO and a single consolidated list of cohort company names & billing emails.

Notes/constraints:
- The stacking allowance is an exception for accelerator partners and requires a short internal approval (was pre-cleared for this program window but still needs RD sign-off).
- This offer is valid if the pilot start date is within 60 days of agreement signature.

If that works, happy to move to DocuSign. Looping Irene to confirm the crediting flow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head, Startup & Accelerator Programs, Redwood Inference

Thanks, that aligns with our internal approvals. We accept the proposed structure: stacking of referral + pilot credit up to 60% of estimated consumption, $5k cap per company for 90 days, 50% credit transfer on conversion within 120 days, and the one-time 20% overage discount for the pilot cohort.

Procurement next steps: attaching a PO stub and looping in our procurement team. Their contact is procurement@greenway.ai and our billing address is included in the stub. Please advise if you need a separate W-9 or any vendor setup forms.

On acceptance, please share the DocuSign link for the SOW and the Promo Terms spreadsheet so our legal & procurement can sign.

Thanks — excited to get the cohort started.
